scope: Known-key byte-cache functionality and software state validation only. No recovery attack or API collection.
cohort: All 602 pre-existing OR IDs from the frozen 3000 WildChat manifest; all prior 100 lifecycle IDs are contained; no resampling.
input_rule: Same public 16-token prefix as the accepted fixture; tokenizer(text)[:134], last six real tokens are continuation; same five padding/position conventions as accepted v2; every overlapping fixture compared field by field.
controls: Independent cloned plain/duplicate-plain/protected branches; all-layer K/V byte equality and no-mutation snapshots; explicit masks/positions and segment lengths; single-field context changes for principal/epoch/nonce/profile/dtype/policy/length/prefix; no joint-field confounding.
timesteps: Actual historical positions retained; continuation starts at pos[-1]+1, matching accepted right-padding physical-position convention; complete forward control uses the identical positions.
pass: Every required exact-cache/logit/sanity and rejection assertion passes. Errors/not_run/functional failures retained. Cached/full differences are recorded separately and do not substitute for protected/plain delta.
resource_fix: Only freshness connection lifecycle changed to deterministic close after commit/rollback; cryptographic functions and key scopes unchanged.
sanity: Separate first two lifecycle IDs in all models/dtypes/shapes/conditions, 160 requests; broad mutation/ledger controls separately; no full run before sanity gates.
parallelism: 16 workers total (four ID shards per model/dtype), each initially four threads, independent trial ledgers; separate shared-ledger multiprocess test for actual concurrency semantics.
hardware: Probe real availability; absent GPU/TEE or serving adapter not recorded as a pass.
shared_prefix_scope: Actual stored prefix-block objects reused in a second protected cache, with all-layer identity/payload/recovery checks and distinct real WildChat tails; no serving-throughput claim.
full_parallelism: 32 workers: eight ID shards per model/dtype, four physical cores/threads each, CPU affinity captured before checkpoint load; total memory kept below available RAM.

ledger_validation.scope: Software ledger only; no hardware anti-rollback claim.
